subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

I am give / a speech on / emerging economic dynamics / in the program.
solution:
The correct answer is "Option 1: **I am give".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

 
• **"I am give"** is not grammatically correct. The correct structure is "I am giving".
